title: Clarify Results and Preview writes hierarchy
objective: Presentation-only refinement of ActionDock and ApprovalDrawer so Preview writes and Results states are distinct and scannable while preserving write semantics, the two-gate commit contract, exact-write disclosure, dialog focus, and 12-hour times.

treatment.approval_drawer_preview: Preview writes state gains a status strip (.drawer-status--preview, role=status) naming the phase (Preview current / stale / loading) and the exact active-write count with 'nothing written yet'; surface totals get their own heading 'Writes by surface'; primary next action remains the two-gate arm ('Looks right — arm live commit').
treatment.approval_drawer_results: Results state gains a distinct status strip (.drawer-status--ok or --partial): 'Committed and verified' on ok, 'Commit incomplete' plus verification-failure count on partial/failed; the Verification heading now precedes the verification list it describes (scan order fix); the single primary next action is a Done button that closes the drawer — never a re-commit affordance.
treatment.dock_entry_point: Results entry is statusful in every applicable state: review sub-label 'preview not built yet' (matches the FEEDBACK-08 intent comment), preview sub-label 'N writes ready' (exact active write count from the current shadow), verified keeps 'statement of work'. Aria-label 'Results — review exact writes and commit result' unchanged.
treatment.scan_hierarchy: Drawer reads top-down as: state status strip -> Writes by surface -> Accepted defects -> Blockers -> Exact writes (collapsed disclosure) -> commit zone; Results reads: state status strip -> Verification (heading -> surface list -> failure detail) -> Done.
treatment.css: New .drawer-status (left accent border 3px var(--t-accent), variants --ok/--partial with --c-free/--c-overflow accents), .drawer-status__label/__detail, .drawer-done, .commit-zone__back class replaces the inline Back margin; at <=520px .commit-zone becomes flex-wrap with gap (armed row never clips), .commit-zone .btn margin-left 0, .drawer-status stacks label over detail.
treatment.unchanged: Two-gate arm -> second-click commit, exact-write disclosure collapsed-by-default, canLiveCommit/shadowBlockers gating, useDialog focus/Escape/restore, display12h rendering, FEEDBACK-23 due-verification markup and raw hover fields.

measurable.preview_status: div.drawer-status.drawer-status--preview role=status; label 'Preview current'; detail '{6} exact writes staged — nothing written yet.' (fixture: 6 of 7 rows active)
measurable.preview_heading: h2 'Preview writes'; h3 'Writes by surface' before .surface-totals
measurable.preview_primary: button 'Looks right — arm live commit' (btn--primary); no 'Done'
measurable.results_status: div.drawer-status--ok on status ok with label 'Committed and verified'; div.drawer-status--partial on partial/failed with label 'Commit incomplete' and detail '{n} verification failure{s} to review'
measurable.results_heading: h2 'Results'; h3 'Verification' DOM position before ul.verify-list
measurable.results_primary: button 'Done' (btn--primary on ok) closes the drawer; no arm-live / Commit-live control in Results
measurable.dock_sublabels: review -> 'preview not built yet'; preview -> '{6} writes ready' (btn--primary); verified -> 'statement of work'

Two-gate live commit (arm -> second click), exact-write disclosure, dialog focus, and 12-hour times intact (asserted in focused suite).
FEEDBACK-13..15 and FEEDBACK-23..29 contracts preserved; FEEDBACK-23 due-verification markup and raw hover fields byte-identical.
FEEDBACK-08 reachability baseline preserved: Results button accessible name, review drawer 'Preview writes' heading + guidance, verified heading 'Results' all unchanged.
No live writes, external mutations, restart, or commit.
